title: Ropedia Xperience-10M Project Brief
summary: A concise first-reader brief for two public evidence lines: one public-sample task lab and one selected-128 public-safe comparison surface.
research_intent: Treat the public Xperience-10M sample as the raw-inspectable development harness, use selected-128 public-safe derived artifacts as the model-comparison surface, and avoid presenting diagnostic results as final model-quality claims.

capability_map.evidence: feature_manifest.json, available_modalities.json, modality atlas, and the episode-window HF viewer
20 unified task contracts, task cards, case-study walkthroughs, and four research-direction extension probes
chronological split, per-task metrics, predictions, confusion matrices, leakage notes, and generated takeaways
final verified 96/16/16 Qwen3-Omni diagnostic result, same-split 128-episode baseline alignment, Cosmos3-Nano compatibility branch, and policy-model candidates after action-space conversion

current_artifacts.status: Line 1 public-sample task lab: 1 public sample episode, 5,821 frames, 1,161 synchronized 20-frame windows
Line 2 selected-128 public-safe artifacts: same-split metadata/raw baselines, Qwen3-Omni v6, Cosmos3-Super, Cosmos3-Nano, and 140 selected-128 scores
Video-derived features, audio, depth, pose/SLAM, mocap, IMU, calibration, and language-derived features
20 embodied-AI task contracts with inputs, targets, metrics, predictions, and setup alignment
Minimal linear/ridge/logistic baselines plus compact PyTorch MLP heads for the unified 20-task public-sample suite
Four Ropedia research directions with direct, proxy, diagnostic, and extension-task coverage
A selected 96/16/16 Qwen3-Omni LoRA final diagnostic result is verified; strict-JSON validity meets target, while weak action/subtask metrics guide the next error-analysis pass

reading_order: Start with the website or PROJECT_BRIEF.md to understand the project shape.
Open RESEARCH_ROADMAP.md to see how the work scales from the public sample to multi-episode modeling.
Open EVALUATION_PROTOCOL.md before comparing task scores.
Use RESEARCH_TAKEAWAYS.md for the current metric interpretation.
Inspect results/episode_task_suite/feature_manifest.json to understand one model input.
Use TASK_SUITE_20.md and docs/data/task_suite_20.json to read the unified 20-task suite; the historical docs/data/tier2_task_suite.json path is retained only for provenance inside that suite.
Use docs/data/omni_finetune_verified_result.json for the current multi-episode Qwen3-Omni pilot result.
scope_boundary: The public sample is the raw-inspectable development harness for task definitions, feature contracts, metrics, visualization, and baseline code. Selected-128 is the same-split model-comparison surface for public-safe baselines and diagnostics; it verifies the training/evaluation loop but does not yet claim strong action/subtask model quality.
next_stage: Improve action/subtask quality through error analysis before presenting larger robustness or alternative-backbone results.
